detail.longDescription: Hi guys. I had an idea to wrote API and some nice WebUI for Fdroid private feed for Android APKs for quite some time. I have some internal applications that I want to share with my family (i.e. smart home management app). First I had just bunch of static files that were managed by my GitLab instance but at some point it broke. Then with growing number of applications and packages and no possibility of managing them easily (I think Fdroid tools are unnecessarily complicated) it was too much to do by hand. With coding agents I decided to try it out and write an application entirely by agent (as kind of experiment) it was usable but quite buggy. And costly. After that I fixed bugs with local model, cleaned up code, added tests, tested it for few weeks myself with Fdroid clients on multiple phones and other devices. It is working and I decided to share it with community. It us an API wrapping Fdroid python packages for managing Fdroid feed, signing APKs and etc. It supports API keys that I am feeding to my CI to upload new APKs after the build. It allows to: - add, update and remove applications - manages their keys so you do not have to - allows to add description and icons - allows to add (with release changes) and remove releases of applications - manages versions of next release It is designed to be integrated with SSO of your choice, because having SSO for your self hosted applications seems much better idea than each of local applications to manage it itself. Links: https://github.com/npodbielski/FdroidManager https://hub.docker.com/r/npodbielski/fdroidmgr/tags I hope it can be of use for more people.
